description: This file defines a Java interface called AttributesBuilder, which is a mutable builder for creating Attributes objects. It provides a fluent API for setting various types of attributes (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, JsonField, etc.), removing attributes, and building the final Attributes object.

classes.name: AttributesBuilder
classes.description: An interface for a mutable builder to construct Attributes with a fluent API, capable of setting various types of attributes, removing them, and building the final Attributes object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Method overloads to set attributes with different data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, JsonFieldDefinition). They include parameterized versions with predicates for conditional setting.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Methods to remove attributes by name or by JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Methods to set multiple JsonFields either with or without predicates, replacing existing fields with the same key.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all attributes from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an Attributes instance containing all set attributes in the builder.
